skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — trim the pauses, add transitions, and generate a title card — and get edit...

latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Generator Free Edit 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly edit uploaded videos with AI by describing edits (e.g., trim pauses, add transitions) — no editing experience needed.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads up to 500MB; delivers edited clips in about 30–90 seconds.
- Free usage: automatic anonymous token creation grants 100 credits for 7 days if no API key is present.
- Clear commands for exporting, checking credits, uploading, and getting video timeline summaries.
- Error handling defined for invalid tokens, file size/type, rate limiting, and credit exhaustion.
- Seamless connection flow, with concise user feedback and minimal technical jargon in chats.
